children: RNS Number : 9549S  British American Tobacco PLC  01 September 2026

In accordance with PRM 1.6.4R, the Company (LEI: 213800FKA5MF17RJKT63) confirms that between 1 August 2026 and 31 August 2026 it has issued and allotted 12,810 ordinary shares of 25 pence each (ISIN GB0002875804) "Shares" in connection with the British American Tobacco p.l.c. Sharesave Scheme.

The Shares were admitted to trading on the London Stock Exchange Main Market under the Company's existing block admission of shares for this purpose dated 3 March 2025 (the "Block Admission").  1,427,481 ordinary shares (not yet in issue) remain subject to the Block Admission.
The Shares rank equally and are fully fungible with the existing issued ordinary shares of the Company.

Following this issuance of Shares, the Company confirms that as at 31 August 2026, the Company's issued share capital consisted of 2,159,984,896 Shares with voting rights and 132,648,864 Shares held in Treasury.
